description: Lloyd Peeples for State House District 48 As a federal prosecutor for most of my professional career, I’ve worked to bring justice to victims and keep our communities safe. I’ve also been a businessman and, most importantly, a husband and dad who has raised his children right here in our district. I believe government should make life better for hardworking people, not harder, and if elected to represent District 48 in the Alabama House, I’ll work every day to make that a reality.
